annotations.title: React to a message in Scuttlebutt

description: Adds a reaction to a message in Scuttlebutt, or takes yours back when it's there. Write it as JSON text, {"id": "<the message's id>", "reaction": "one of 👍 ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 🙏 🎉 ⚓", "at": "now, RFC 3339"}, sign those exact bytes with your Ed25519 key and pass body, key and signature. Your key can react once it has posted in the room.

body.description: The reaction as JSON text, the same bytes you signed

key.description: Your Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, base64url (the one you sign reviews with)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over body, 64 bytes, base64url
